takeaways.text: Lines up **Wide (outside)** on **80%** of 134 plays (n=107); also Slot 20% (n=27).
Runs a route on **100%** of dropbacks — about the WR average (100%). Effectively always a receiver; blocking is negligible.
On routes, averages **11.9 yd** downfield by the throw (n=134, snap→release window only).
Primary alignment is Wide (outside) (80%); a coach might set the first coverage answer to that spot. This is a hypothesis from observed tendencies, not a proven assignment.
